info.title: HITL Agent Access Reference API
info.description: Optional hitl-agent-access/0.1; bindings hitl-agent-access-public-web/0.1 and hitl-agent-access-delegated-api/0.1. DPoP token/proof requirements are conjunctive. Browser sessions are independent reviewer identities. The context does not authorize execution.

DPoPAccessToken.description: DPoP-bound access token; a Bearer token is rejected.

DPoPProof.name: DPoP
DPoPProof.description: RFC 9449 request proof including method, URI, token hash, replay protection, and server nonce.

HttpMessageSignature.name: Signature
HttpMessageSignature.description: RFC 9421 plus pinned Web Bot Auth WG draft 00. Requires Signature-Input and dictionary Signature-Agent; signed method and target are mandatory.

HttpMessageSignatureInput.name: Signature-Input
HttpMessageSignatureInput.description: RFC 9421 covered components and signature parameters, correlated by dictionary key.

SignatureAgent.name: Signature-Agent
SignatureAgent.description: Web Bot Auth WG draft 00 dictionary identifies the signing entity for each signature label.

BrowserSession.name: __Host-hitl-session
BrowserSession.description: Independently authenticated owner session; loopback development uses hitl-session. Review rendering/submission additionally requires a case-scoped capability. Browser mutations require matching HttpOnly __Host-hitl-csrf (development hitl-csrf), hidden csrf body value, persisted hash, and trusted Origin.

HitlObject.title: HITL Object
HitlObject.description: The hitl object within an HTTP 202 response, as defined by HITL Protocol v0.9

spec_version.description: Protocol version. MUST be '0.9' for this spec.

case_id.description: Unique, URL-safe identifier for this review case. RECOMMENDED format: review_{random}

review_url.description: Fully qualified review URL to the review page. MUST be HTTPS in production. For local development, http://localhost and http://127.0.0.1 are allowed.

poll_url.description: Fully qualified URL to the status polling endpoint. MUST be HTTPS in production. For local development, http://localhost and http://127.0.0.1 are allowed.

callback_url.description: If the agent provided a callback URL in the original request, it is echoed here. Otherwise null.

events_url.description: Optional SSE endpoint for real-time status events.

type.description: Review type category. One of the five standard types, or a custom type prefixed with 'x-'.

prompt.description: Short description of what the human needs to decide.

timeout.description: Duration the review stays open. ISO 8601 duration (PT24H, P7D) or shorthand (24h, 7d). Default: 24h.

default_action.description: Action taken if the review expires without a response.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the review case was created.

expires_at.description: Timestamp when the review case expires.

form.description: Structured form definition for Input-type reviews. Use either 'fields' (single-step) or 'steps' (multi-step), not both.

fields.description: Array of form field definitions for single-step forms.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier for form state persistence. Enables resume after browser close.

title.description: Step heading displayed in the wizard UI.

description.description: Subtitle or helper text for the step.

fields.description: Array of form field definitions for this step.

steps.description: Array of wizard steps for multi-step forms.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier for form state persistence. Enables resume after browser close.

context.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs providing additional context about the review.

reminder_at.description: When reminder(s) should be sent. Single timestamp or array of timestamps.

previous_case_id.description: Links to a prior case in a multi-round review chain.

format.description: UI format identifier (e.g., json-render, a2ui, adaptive-cards)

surface.description: Optional declaration of the review page UI format.

submit_url.description: API endpoint where the agent MAY submit simple responses on behalf of the human via native messaging buttons.

submit_token.description: Opaque bearer token for authenticating agent submissions via submit_url.

inline_actions.description: Actions permitted via submit_url without visiting review_url.

verification_policy.description: Optional verification requirements. The core standardizes proof_of_human; profiles may define x-prefixed requirements for service-verified identity or authorization.

PollResponse.title: HITL Poll Response
PollResponse.description: Response from the poll endpoint, as defined by HITL Protocol v0.9

status.description: Current status of the review case.

opened_at.description: When the human first opened the review URL.

completed_at.description: When the human submitted their response.

action.description: The action taken by the human.

data.description: Structured data from the review. Content depends on the review type.

signer.description: URL to the signer's JWKS endpoint.

signature.description: Optional cryptographic signature for response integrity.

result.description: The human's response. Present only when status is 'completed'.

responded_by.description: Optional identity of the person who submitted the response.

submission_context.description: Normalized information about the submission path and verification outcome.

current_step.description: The step the human is currently on (1-indexed).

total_steps.description: Total number of steps in the form.

completed_fields.description: Number of fields the human has filled so far.

total_fields.description: Total number of required fields across all steps.

progress.description: Optional progress tracking for multi-step Input forms.

reminder_sent_at.description: When the last reminder was sent.

next_case_id.description: If a follow-up case was created, links to the next case in the chain.

default_action.description: The default action declared when the case was created. Present when status is expired.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for cancellation. Present when status is 'cancelled'.

FormField.title: HITL Form Field
FormField.description: A form field definition used in context.form for Input-type reviews, as defined by HITL Protocol v0.9

key.description: Unique identifier for the field. Used as key in result.data.

label.description: Human-readable label displayed next to the field.

type.description: Field type. Standard types: text, textarea, number, date, email, url, boolean, select, multiselect, range. Services MAY extend with x-prefixed custom types.

required.description: Whether the field must be filled before submission.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text shown when the field is empty.

hint.description: Help text displayed below or beside the field.

default.description: Pre-filled value. MUST NOT contain sensitive data — use default_ref instead.

default_ref.description: URL to securely fetch a pre-fill value. Used instead of default for sensitive data. Requires review URL token for access.

sensitive.description: If true, the review page SHOULD mask the input and MUST NOT log the value.

options.description: Available choices. Required for select and multiselect types.

minLength.description: Minimum character length. Applies to: text, textarea, email, url.

maxLength.description: Maximum character length. Applies to: text, textarea, email, url.

pattern.description: Regular expression the value must match. Applies to: text, email, url.

min.description: Minimum value or earliest date. Applies to: number, range, date.

max.description: Maximum value or latest date. Applies to: number, range, date.

field.description: The key of the field this condition depends on.

value.description: The value to compare against. For 'in' operator, an array of values.

conditional.description: Conditional visibility. When the condition is not met, the field is hidden and excluded from result.data.

SubmitRequest.title: Inline Submit Request
SubmitRequest.description: Request body for agent-submitted responses via submit_url, as defined by HITL Protocol v0.9

action.description: The action taken by the human via a native messaging button. MUST be a valid action for the review type and listed in inline_actions if specified.

data.description: Structured data accompanying the action. For simple inline actions, this is typically empty {}.

submitted_via.description: Identifies the submission channel for audit purposes.

display_name.description: Human-readable display name of the user who triggered the action.

verification_evidence.description: Optional opaque verification evidence relayed from a human-controlled proof flow. Services must verify it server-side.

proof_type.description: Normative core value in v0.9 is proof_of_human.

provider.description: Provider identifier for the proof presentation.

format.description: Presentation format used by the provider evidence.

presentation.description: Opaque provider payload. Agents must treat this as opaque.

binding.description: Provider-agnostic binding hints relayed to the service.

DiscoveryResponse.title: HITL Discovery Response
DiscoveryResponse.description: Response body for GET /.well-known/hitl.json, as defined by HITL Protocol v0.9.

spec_version.description: Protocol version supported by the service discovery document.

supports_agent_binding.description: Whether the service can bind review execution to the initiating agent or host via an external auth/control-plane profile.

supports_surface.description: Whether the service publishes optional declarative surface payloads via a separate interop profile in addition to the required review_url fallback.

surface_formats.description: Declarative UI surface formats the service may publish via optional interop profiles.

surface_profiles.description: Optional surface interop profiles supported by the service.

profiles.description: External authentication or agent-binding profiles the service composes with HITL.

well_known.description: Optional well-known endpoint for an external auth or agent-binding control plane.

documentation.description: Documentation for the service's external auth or agent-binding model.

VerificationPolicy.title: Verification Policy
VerificationPolicy.description: Optional verification policy for HITL Protocol v0.9. Defines when proof_of_human evidence is required and how it must be bound.

mode.description: Whether verification evidence is optional, required, or only required as a step-up.

required_for.description: Submission paths for which verification must be satisfied.

any_of.description: OR-of-AND policy logic. Any option may satisfy the policy; each option requires all listed evidence requirements.

case_id.description: Whether accepted evidence must be bound to the HITL case_id.

action.description: Whether accepted evidence must be bound to the submitted action.

challenge.description: Opaque service-generated challenge for provider-specific binding.

freshness_seconds.description: Maximum age of the accepted evidence at the time of verification.

expires_at.description: Absolute policy expiry timestamp for the verification challenge.

single_use.description: Whether equivalent evidence can only be used once for the declared case/action binding.

on_missing.description: Fallback behavior when required evidence is missing.

on_invalid.description: Fallback behavior when presented evidence fails verification.

proof_type.description: Normative core value in v0.9 is proof_of_human. Custom extensions MUST use x- prefixes.

provider.description: Provider identifier (for example world_id). Omit to accept any provider for the proof type.

min_assurance.description: Minimum service-defined assurance level required for this proof.

presentation_formats.description: Optional allowed presentation formats for provider evidence.

VerificationResult.title: Verification Result
VerificationResult.description: Normalized verification outcome for HITL Protocol v0.9. Raw provider payloads must not be returned here.

satisfied.description: Whether the declared verification policy was satisfied.

proof_type.description: Normalized proof type that was accepted.

provider.description: Provider that produced the accepted evidence.

assurance_level.description: Service-defined assurance level after provider verification.

bound_to_case.description: Whether the service verified binding to the HITL case_id.

bound_to_action.description: Whether the service verified binding to the submitted action.

fresh.description: Whether the evidence satisfied the service freshness window.

single_use_enforced.description: Whether the service enforced single-use semantics for the accepted evidence.

verified_at.description: Timestamp at which the provider verification result was accepted.

verified_evidence.description: Normalized accepted evidence only. No provider proof material or secrets.

missing_requirements.description: Human-readable identifiers for requirement branches that were not satisfied.

SubmissionContext.title: Submission Context
SubmissionContext.description: Context about how a completed HITL review was submitted in v0.9.

submitted_via.description: Audit string describing the submission channel or surface.

submitted_by.description: Submission origin metadata for inline-path auditability.

verification_result.description: Normalized outcome of the service-side verification flow.
